reviewed_non_single_species_exclusions.catalog_evidence_literal: Lipotropic C is a liquid research blend with two options: Cyanocobalamin B12 (Original) and Methylcobalamin B12 + NADH (New). Select the formulation explicitly. The published cyanocobalamin report provides no numeric purity percentage and does not verify the newer formulation. Review formulation-specific documentation before selecting material for laboratory research.

SHB Super Human Blend is a research blend containing amino acids, L-carnitine and NAC. Review the listed product and available formulation or lot documentation before selecting the material for laboratory work. The product is supplied for research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

Lipotropic B is a liquid research blend with two formulations: Cyanocobalamin B12 (Original) and Methylcobalamin B12 (New). The Original formulation contains eight listed components, with the following nominal amounts per milliliter of solution: L-carnitine 20 mg, L-arginine 20 mg, methionine 25 mg, inositol 50 mg, choline 50 mg, vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) 25 mg, vitamin B5 (dexpanthenol) 25 mg and vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) 1 mg. The Original formulation is labeled as a 10 mL unit. Its single-unit offer contains one unit, and its 10-pack contains ten units of that same formulation, totaling a nominal 100 mL. These concentrations and volume apply to the Original formulation; they are not assigned to the New Methylcobalamin formulation. The published cyanocobalamin sample report lists identity and other tests but no numeric purity percentage. Both formulations have single-unit offers and matching 10-unit packs.

Vitamin B12 is available as Cyanocobalamin (Cyano) or Methylcobalamin (Methyl). Choose the formulation explicitly and review its documentation. The Blue Cap COA on the source listing applies to cyanocobalamin only and does not cover methylcobalamin. For laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.

GLOW Blend contains a nominal 70 mg per vial: 50 mg GHK-Cu, 10 mg BPC-157 and 10 mg TB-500. The source identifies the TB-500 component as Ac-LKKTETQ, an acetylated seven-residue fragment, not full-length thymosin beta-4. Match the lot to its analytical report. For laboratory research only.

Wolverine is a combined lyophilized BPC-157 and TB-500 research material, also called the Wolverine blend. Confirm the supplied lot's component identities, amounts, ratio and formulation. No lot-specific COA is currently linked on the source listing. For in-vitro laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.

BNG Scientific bacteriostatic water, also called reconstitution solution, is labeled 0.9% benzyl alcohol. One box contains two 10 mL vials; quantity 1 means one box, and individual vials are not sold separately. Review the matching lot COA. For laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.

KLOW is a nominal 80 mg research blend containing BPC-157, KPV, TB-500 and GHK-Cu. The source identifies its TB-500 component as Ac-LKKTETQ, the acetylated seven-residue thymosin beta-4 fragment. Review current lot-specific identity and quantitative-content documentation. For laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.

literature_sources.finding: Baar et al. define a particular FOXO4-DRI sequence, D stereochemistry and cell-entry construct. The catalog does not identify that construct; no product mapping follows.
Esposito et al. identified Ac-LKKTETQ in the particular tested TB-500 formulation. This does not define every commercial TB-500 material.
Morozov and Khavinson describe extracted natural thymic peptides as Thymalin and a constituent isolated from that preparation. This does not establish the catalog material as nonathymulin.
